coverage: Two remaining Wolverhampton races reviewed. This is an editorial paper-research shortlist, not a validated value model or a complete card ranking.

decisions.betting_verdict: PASS for a real-money value bet at the displayed shortened price.
decisions.reason: She has already won over this Wolverhampton course and distance. Her latest listed Southwell run was off a mark of 84; today’s listed mark is 82. Taylor’s analysis makes a specific case for upgrading that latest effort on an artificial surface.
decisions.counter: Um Wadi is a serious rival; Rogue Citation leads both experimental model rankings. The new model failed its initial test, and none of these opinions supplies a calibrated win probability.
decisions.price: ATR’s Hugh Taylor page displayed 15/8 for bet365 / William Hill when checked around 18:42 UK. This is an aggregator reference, not a directly verified executable or Sky Bet quote. His column’s 3/1 is an earlier publication price.
decisions.why_price_matters: 15/8 requires about 34.8% winners to break even before deductions. We have not established that win probability; the earlier 3/1 must not be treated as still available.
